sentences.zh: 太子性剛，知賈謐恃後之貴，不能假借之。

translations.literal: The crown prince's temper was stiff; knowing Jia Mi relied on the empress's power, he would not indulge him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu refused to flatter Jia Mi.

sentences.zh: 謐至東宮，或舍之而於後庭遊戲。

translations.literal: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.
translations.idiomatic: He left Jia Mi cooling heels while he played inside.

sentences.zh: 詹事裴權諫曰：「賈謐甚有寵于中宮，而有不順之色，若一旦交構，大事去矣。

translations.literal: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: 'Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: "Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.

sentences.zh: 宜深自謙屈，以防其變，廣延賢士，用自輔翼。」

translations.literal: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings.'
translations.idiomatic: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings."

sentences.zh: 太子不能從。

translations.literal: The crown prince would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Yu ignored him.

sentences.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。

translations.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Huai once pushed a Han match—Yu wanted it too.

sentences.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。

translations.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Wu and the empress forced Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng instead.

sentences.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。

translations.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.
translations.idiomatic: Yu resented losing Wang's elder beauty to Jia Mi.

sentences.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。

translations.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
translations.idiomatic: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

sentences.zh: 密聞其言云：'皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之。

translations.literal: I have secretly heard him say: "After the empress dies, I shall butcher them."
translations.idiomatic: Mi quoted Yu vowing to slaughter the Jias after Jia died.

sentences.zh: '非但如是也，若宮車晏駕，彼居大位，依楊氏故事，誅臣等而廢後於金墉，如反手耳。

translations.literal: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.
translations.idiomatic: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.

sentences.zh: 不如早為之所，更立慈順者以自防衛。」

translations.literal: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves.'
translations.idiomatic: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves."

sentences.zh: 後納其言，又宣揚太子之短，布諸遠近。

translations.literal: The empress accepted his words and further broadcast the crown prince's faults throughout near and far.
translations.idiomatic: Jia adopted the plot and smeared Yu empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意。

translations.literal: Then court and countryside knew the empress meant to harm the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone saw Jia meant to kill the heir.

sentences.zh: 中護軍趙俊請太子廢後，太子不聽。

translations.literal: Central Guard Zhao Jun asked the crown prince to depose the empress first; the crown prince refused.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jun urged preemptive deposition—Yu declined.

sentences.zh: 初，太子之廢也，妃父王衍表請離婚。

translations.literal: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan filed for divorce the moment Yu fell.

sentences.zh: 太子至許，遺妃書曰：「鄙雖頑愚，心念為善，欲盡忠孝之節，無有惡逆之心。

translations.literal: After the crown prince reached Xu he sent his consort a letter: 'Though I am coarse and foolish at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.
translations.idiomatic: After reaching Xu he sent his consort a letter: "Though I am coarse and foolish, at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.

sentences.zh: 雖非中宮所生，奉事有如親母。

translations.literal: Though not born of the inner palace I served her as my own mother.
translations.idiomatic: He claimed dutiful service to Jia despite birth.

sentences.zh: 自為太子以來，敕見禁檢，不得見母。

translations.literal: Since becoming crown prince edicts confined me—I could not see my mother.
translations.idiomatic: Palace rules barred him from Lady Xie.

sentences.zh: 自宜城君亡，不見存恤，恆在空室中坐。

translations.literal: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.

sentences.zh: 去年十二月，道文疾病困篤，父子之情，實相憐湣。

translations.literal: Last twelfth month Daowen's illness grew desperate—father and son pitied each other truly.
translations.idiomatic: Last twelfth month Daowen became gravely ill; the affection between father and son made us deeply pity one another.

sentences.zh: 于時表國家乞加徽號，不見聽許。

translations.literal: Then I petitioned the throne for honors—permission never came.
translations.idiomatic: His plea for son's title failed.

sentences.zh: 疾病既篤，為之求請恩福，無有噁心。

translations.literal: When illness grew grave I sought blessings for him—I bore no evil intent.
translations.idiomatic: He denied malice in praying for the boy.

sentences.zh: 自道文病，中宮三遣左右來視，云：'天教呼汝。

translations.literal: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."
translations.idiomatic: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."

sentences.zh: '到二十八日暮，有短函來，題言東宮發，疏云：'言天教欲見汝。

translations.literal: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."

sentences.zh: '即便作表求入。

translations.literal: At once I drafted a memorial begging entry.
translations.idiomatic: He requested audience.

sentences.zh: 二十九日早入見國家，須臾遣至中宮。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth morning I entered and saw His Majesty; presently I was sent to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: He saw Hui briefly then reached Jia's halls.

sentences.zh: 中宮左右陳舞見語：'中宮旦來吐不快。

translations.literal: Inner attendants Chen Wu told him: 'The empress vomited ill this morning.'
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wu claimed Jia was sick.

sentences.zh: '使住空屋中坐。

translations.literal: She told you to wait seated in an empty chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They parked him in an empty room.

sentences.zh: 須臾中宮遣陳舞見語：'聞汝表陛下為道文乞王，不得王是成國耳。

translations.literal: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'
translations.idiomatic: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'

sentences.zh: '中宮遙呼陳舞：'昨天教與太子酒棗。

translations.literal: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."

sentences.zh: '便持三升酒、大盤棗來見與，使飲酒啖棗盡。

translations.literal: She brought three sheng of ale and a great tray of jujubes and made him finish both.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wu forced three sheng wine and dates.

sentences.zh: 鄙素不飲酒，即便遣舞啟說不堪三升之意。

translations.literal: I never drink ale yet sent Chen Wu back explaining I could not manage three sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yu pleaded low tolerance.

sentences.zh: 中宮遙呼曰：'汝常陛下前持酒可喜，何以不飲？

translations.literal: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'
translations.idiomatic: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'

sentences.zh: 天與汝酒，當使道文差也。

translations.literal: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.

sentences.zh: '便答中宮：'陛下會同一日見賜，故不敢辭，通日不飲三升酒也。

translations.literal: I answered the inner palace: His Majesty granted ale one day—therefore I dared not refuse—but all day I never drank three sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yu cited earlier imperial banquet.

sentences.zh: 且實未食，恐不堪。

translations.literal: Moreover I had not eaten—I feared I could not endure it.
translations.idiomatic: Empty stomach worried him.

sentences.zh: 又未見殿下，飲此或至顛倒。

translations.literal: Nor had I yet seen Your Highness—I feared drink might overturn me.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, I had not yet seen Your Highness, and drinking this might leave me confused and unsteady.

sentences.zh: '陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！

translations.literal: Chen Wu relayed another message: "You unfilial wretch!
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wu called him unfilial.

sentences.zh: 天與汝酒飲，不肯飲，中有惡物邪？

translations.literal: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?
translations.idiomatic: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?

sentences.zh: '遂可飲二升，餘有一升，求持還東宮飲盡。

translations.literal: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.
translations.idiomatic: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.

sentences.zh: 逼迫不得已，更飲一升。

translations.literal: Pressed helplessly he drank another sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered he drank more.

sentences.zh: 飲已，體中荒迷，不復自覺。

translations.literal: After drinking his body grew confused and he lost awareness.
translations.idiomatic: After drinking it, I became dazed and lost awareness.

sentences.zh: 須臾有一小婢持封箱來，云：'詔使寫此文書。

translations.literal: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case, saying, 'The edict orders you to write out this document.'
translations.idiomatic: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case and said, "The emperor orders you to copy this document."

sentences.zh: '鄙便驚起，視之，有一白紙，一青紙。

translations.literal: I started in alarm and looked: there was one sheet of white paper and one of green.
translations.idiomatic: He found white and green paper inside.

sentences.zh: 催促云：'陛下停待。

translations.literal: They pressed: 'His Majesty is waiting.'
translations.idiomatic: Runners said the emperor waited.

sentences.zh: '又小婢承福持筆研墨黃紙來，使寫。

translations.literal: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making him write.
translations.idiomatic: Chengfu added brush and yellow paper for the copy.

sentences.zh: 急疾不容復視，實不覺紙上語輕重。

translations.literal: Haste would not let me reread; I truly did not notice the import of the words on the page.
translations.idiomatic: Rush left no time to read the forgery's sense.

sentences.zh: 父母至親，實不相疑，事理如此，實為見誣，想眾人見明也。」

translations.literal: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'
translations.idiomatic: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'
